an10.171:1.1: adhammo ca bhikkhave veditabbo anattho ca
an10.171:1.3: adhammañca viditvā anatthañca dhammañca viditvā atthañca yathā dhammo yathā attho tathā paṭipajjitabbaṃ.
an10.171:2.1: katamo ca bhikkhave adhammo ca anattho ca
an10.171:2.2: pāṇātipāto adinnādānaṃ kāmesu micchācāro musāvādo pisuṇā vācā pharusā vācā samphappalāpo abhijjhā byāpādo micchādiṭṭhi
an10.171:2.3: ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave adhammo ca anattho ca.
an10.171:3.1: katamo ca bhikkhave dhammo ca attho ca
an10.171:3.2: pāṇātipātā veramaṇī adinnādānā veramaṇī kāmesu micchācārā veramaṇī musāvādā veramaṇī pisuṇāya vācāya veramaṇī pharusāya vācāya veramaṇī samphappalāpā veramaṇī anabhijjhā abyāpādo sammādiṭṭhi
an10.171:3.3: ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave dhammo ca attho ca.
an10.171:4.1: adhammo ca bhikkhave veditabbo anattho ca
an10.171:4.3: adhammañca viditvā anatthañca dhammañca viditvā atthañca yathā dhammo yathā attho tathā paṭipajjitabbanti
an10.171:4.4: iti yantaṃ vuttaṃ idametaṃ paṭicca vuttanti.
